{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates based on patient_id
print("Duplicate patient_id:", df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum())

# Check for missing values
print("Missing values per column:\n", df.isnull().sum())

# Check the distribution of sites
print("Site distribution:\n", df['site'].value_counts())

# Check the distribution of arms
print("Arm distribution:\n", df['arm'].value_counts())

# Check the distribution of severity
print("Severity distribution:\n", df['severity'].value_counts())"}
